key_provisions_or_claims: Risk-based tiers: prohibited practices (Art. 5), high-risk systems, limited-risk transparency duties
Bans subliminal manipulation, exploitation of vulnerabilities, public social scoring, and real-time remote biometric ID in public spaces with exceptions
High-risk AI must meet requirements on risk management, data governance, documentation, human oversight, accuracy and robustness
Conformity assessment and CE marking, with links to sectoral product safety law (machinery, vehicles, medical devices)
Establishes a European Artificial Intelligence Board, national authorities, sandboxes and penalties
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: European Commission's April 2021 proposal for the Artificial Intelligence Act (2021/0106(COD)), captured via the Parliament's Legislative Observatory. It sets a horizontal, risk-based framework with prohibited practices, high-risk requirements, conformity assessment, transparency duties, governance bodies and penalties, linked to sectoral product safety legislation.
annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts
